scope: Read-only archive integrity compatibility for Linux-host final inventory; no candidate, grading, fixture, run metadata or acceptance changes.

inventory_selection.fallback: evidence/linux-host.json.final_files only when declared by the archive and its original artifact hash is validated by a run evidence or score binding
inventory_selection.dual_records: Both normalized path/sha256/mode sets must match exactly; array ordering may differ.
inventory_selection.linux_validation: Required modes; safe relative unique paths; lowercase 64-hex SHA256; integer permissions from 0 through 0777. Malformed JSON, missing or malformed inventories, unbound artifacts and conflicts fail.
inventory_selection.completeness: Existing complete_source_trees exact declared and on-disk path-set checks and original source hash bindings are unchanged, including project/dependency separation.
inventory_selection.mode_limit: Linux modes are validated and compared between dual inventory records; archived filesystem chmod equality is not a new guarantee. Existing publication permission semantics are retained.

new_test_coverage: Linux-only complete native acceptance without rewriting run.json; missing dependency still rejected
Equivalent dual inventories with reordered rows; source binding from score or run evidence list
Dual path/hash/mode/membership conflicts, including missing run mode
Absent evidence, unbound host artifact, wrong host hash and identical hash bound only under a different artifact path
Published source substitution for trial and candidate-dependency trees

preservation.test_fixtures: New synthetic disposable tests; historical evaluation fixtures/results/run files were not edited.
preservation.run_json: No final_files field invented or injected; fallback consumes the recorded Linux artifact.
preservation.archive_checker: Read-only existing archive scan, not export, grading or experiment rerun.

limits: Native attempt 54 not exported by this change.
No host compliance, production behavior or candidate quality verdict follows from integrity acceptance.
No models or supplied runtime/verifier fixtures executed.
